content.value_statement: Teams waste time comparing outdated event lists and incomplete trade show directories. This skill researches current shows, compares options, and turns event discovery into a practical shortlist.
actual_capabilities: Finds trade shows from industry, region, timeframe, and business goal criteria.
Compares events by date, venue, exhibitor count, visitor count, and focus area.
Verifies current dates and official URLs through web search when available.
Ranks top picks for attending, exhibiting, distributor search, or competitor research.
Adds practical context such as deadlines, co-located events, travel notes, and alternatives.
Marks uncertain statistics as estimated or TBC instead of inventing numbers.
limitations: Requires web search access for current dates, URLs, and attendance figures.
Some event directories may block access or publish incomplete data.
Exhibitor and visitor counts can be estimates when official sources are unavailable.
Does not replace official event contracts, pricing, legal, or travel advice.

use_cases.title: Build an Exhibition Shortlist
use_cases.description: Identify the most relevant shows for a product category, region, and target buyer profile.

use_cases.title: Plan Market Expansion
use_cases.description: Compare regional trade fairs to find where distributors, buyers, and partners are likely to attend.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Named Events
use_cases.description: Compare known shows side by side and decide which one best supports a launch or scouting goal.

prompt_templates.title: Find Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Find trade shows for [industry] in [region] over the next 12 months. Include dates, location, audience size, and top recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Named Shows
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [show A], [show B], and [show C] for a [company type] that wants to [goal]. Rank them and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Regional Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 2026 trade show calendar for [industry] across [regions]. Group shows by quarter, flag strongest fit for attending versus exhibiting, and note data confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Exhibiting Investment
prompt_templates.prompt: We sell [product] to [buyer profile] and have [budget]. Research relevant shows in [region], then score each for lead potential, cost fit, competitor presence, and follow-up value.

output_examples.input: Find packaging trade shows in Europe for Q2 and Q3 2026.
output_examples.output: A ranked table of packaging events with dates, venues, estimated scale, focus areas, official links, and a short list of top recommendations.

output_examples.input: Compare CES, MWC, and IFA for a consumer electronics startup.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison of audience fit, launch value, buyer profile, cost considerations, and a decision guide for which show to prioritize.

output_examples.input: We need distributors in the Middle East for industrial automation equipment.
output_examples.output: A regional shortlist of relevant industrial and manufacturing shows, with notes on buyer fit, attendance goals, and follow-up planning.

best_practices: Provide the industry, region, time range, and whether the goal is attending or exhibiting.
Ask for source links and confidence notes for each recommendation.
Reconfirm dates, deadlines, and booth rules on official event sites before booking.
anti_patterns: Asking for every event worldwide without priority criteria.
Treating estimated visitor counts as guaranteed attendance.
Choosing a show only by size without checking buyer fit or budget.

faq.question: Does this skill find current trade shows?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to use web search for current dates, venues, official links, and recent attendance data when browsing is available.

faq.question: Can it compare trade shows I already know?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the show names, your company type, and your goal. The skill can rank the options and explain tradeoffs.

faq.question: Does it include exhibitor and visitor counts?
faq.answer: Yes, when reliable sources are available. It should mark numbers as estimated or TBC when official data is missing.

faq.question: Can it build an annual trade show calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize events by quarter, region, or priority to support annual planning.

faq.question: Is this skill limited to one industry?
faq.answer: No. It can research many sectors, including medical devices, packaging, manufacturing, food, automotive, and consumer technology.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your industry, region, time range, target audience, and whether you plan to attend, exhibit, or research competitors.
